fields.name: map_walls
fields.meaning: Static wall; closed shortcut doors are not walls

fields.name: time_and_goal
fields.meaning: mode_id 0 basic or 1 relaxed; reject budgets over 512

fields.name: items
fields.meaning: Stable heat_00..09 slots; inactive all zero

fields.name: ghosts
fields.meaning: direction_bit 0=-1,1=+1; inactive zero; current position derived from route[index]

fields.name: shortcuts
fields.meaning: A then B. Stable slot binds terminal to gate; inactive zero

fields.name: quest
fields.meaning: Mandatory object position and possession; item type is cosmetic only

fields.name: patrol_speeds
fields.meaning: Stable A/B slots; absent patrol is zero

fields.name: chaser
fields.meaning: Absent chaser is all zero; configured inactive chaser retains its spawn and timing

fields.name: magnet
fields.meaning: Absent magnet is all zero; collected magnet retains its position. Pickup tick counts toward the 13-tick 3x3 effect; barriers do not block collection. Animation is excluded.

fields.name: invincibility
fields.meaning: Absent item is all zero. Pickup tick counts toward 10 protected ticks. Independent of post-damage protection; contacts still stun the chaser.

rules: Semantic state must be validated before encoding
A policy with a different observation version must not be silently loaded
External experiment cutoff is truncated=true, not game failure
Gymnasium adapter is implemented; no RL training is included
